label: Early original-phase input (steps 2-3) of q/e/g/l/v/n/3/u/w/x
explanation: Fires almost only in the original phase at positions 2 and 3 (97.6% of activation mass; t=4 gives 2.4%, t=5 almost nothing; it never fires at t=0-1, and is essentially silent on <DEL> (37 steps) and the whole copy phase). Within those positions it depends on which token is input: q is strongest (26% of mass, 20% rate), then e, g, l, v, followed by n, 3, u, w, x; b and o are weak, and many other tokens hardly fire. It favors first occurrences of a token (94% of mass has in_first=1). Magnitude also goes up with certain preceding tokens: the top activations (about 0.04) are q following d, as in "j d q" and "h k d q", and prev/prev2 tokens d, r, h, k raise the rate. The context dependence on earlier tokens is not captured by the predicate, so precision and recall stay around 0.75.
